subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks the ghost is Pelek.
source_quote: The ghost," he thinks.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir thinks to himself: "Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - ..."
source_quote: Leemooggoogoon, Demogorgon, two-headed baby dragons - …

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir wonders whether condemning the Derro and Duergar to a genocidal war is the right thing to do.
source_quote: But is that the right thing to do?” he wonders.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers a text from the temple about the power of Bahamut: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes.”
source_quote: "When the egg, crimson-hued, promises but a shadow's ride, does one mend the shell, or seek to free the spark within? The true wyrm's form is not etched by fate's first breath, nor by sorcerous hand. It is the choices that twist the spirit, or set it soaring. To break the chains of another's dark design, even when madness fuels the crafting, is to affirm the very freedom Bahamut cherishes."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum remembers how Bahamut’s clerics never gave him a straight answer.
source_quote: He remembers how Bahamut’s clerics never gave him a straight answer.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum believes the egg should be destroyed because it is no longer a dragon but a physical manifestation of a demon.
source_quote: The egg is no longer a dragon. It is a physical manifestation of a demon. The egg should be destroyed.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum mutters, "The Second Faction?"
source_quote: The Second Faction?

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is appalled by Thorin's desire for a dragon.
source_quote: Grygum is appalled.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum realizes Thorin's words about dragons might have offended Zalthir and tries to retract them.
source_quote: I’m sorry. I didn’t mean that we don’t have a pure dragon, and that I wanted a pure dragon.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin wants to have a dragon because it would be cool.
source_quote: I would like to have a dragon. It would be so cool if we had a dragon.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin is pleased with the name "The Ember Vanguard" and feels it makes their group seem feared rather than pathetic.
source_quote: The mage likes the idea of being a feared group of mercenaries instead of a pathetic group of adventurers who are running around trying to stay alive.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin believes they need a name for their group.
source_quote: We need a name.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir mutters that he votes they get out of Gracklstugh as discreetly as possible, creating the least amount of chaos as possible.
source_quote: I vote we get out of here as discreetly as possible, creating the least amount of chaos as possible.

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin just wants to live.
source_quote: He just wants to live.

subject: Diirdeklin
fact: Diirdeklin thinks the Drow incursion is not good and that if they killed Pliinki, they have bigger plans.
source_quote: A Drow incursion! This is not good. And if they killed Pliinki, that means that they have bigger plans.

subject: Diinarnnmyr
fact: Diinarnnmyr mutters that the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue the Derro.
source_quote: The Ember Vanguard - the Drow are now working with the Duergar to subdue us!

subject: The Ember Vanguard
fact: The group adopts the name "The Ember Vanguard," but its origins and true purpose remain undefined beyond Thorin's impulsive suggestion.
source_quote: I have it - The Ember Vanguard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz has found purpose and believes he is the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: He has found purpose. He is the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard!

subject: Daz
fact: Daz ponders his spell list and has some intriguing ideas, but realizes that the old standby, Magic Missile, is probably the best bet.
source_quote: Daz ponders his spell list and has some intriguing ideas, but realizes that the old standby, Magic Missile, is probably the best bet.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz grits his teeth as he hears Grygum’s muffled sounds of pain and watches as the Orc can’t escape.
source_quote: Daz grits his teeth as he hears Grygum’s muffled sounds of pain and watches as the Orc can’t escape.
